## Specification

### Component: Empty state

What to show when a list, table or search has nothing in it: say what is missing and offer one next step. Presentational, Server Component–safe.

#### Anatomy
```
<Empty>                    <div class="ui-empty [ui-empty-dashed | ui-empty-card]">
  <EmptyHeader>            <div class="ui-empty-header">
    <EmptyMedia />         <div class="ui-empty-media ui-empty-media-icon | -illustration">
    <EmptyTitle />         <h3 class="ui-empty-title">   (as: h2–h6 | div)
    <EmptyDescription />   <p class="ui-empty-description">
  <EmptyActions />         <div class="ui-empty-actions">
```

#### Props
- `Empty`: `variant` — `default` (no container) · `dashed` (1px dashed outline) · `card` (solid border + surface).
- `EmptyMedia`: `variant` — `icon` (default: icon in a 48px tile) · `illustration` (free slot, max 12rem wide).
- `EmptyTitle`: `as` — `h3` default; `h2`–`h6` or `div`.
- Every part forwards `ref`, `className` and native props.

#### Visual rules
- `.ui-empty`: flex column, centred, `padding: 2.5rem 1.5rem`, gap 1.25rem, text centred.
- `-dashed`: `border: 1px dashed var(--ui-border-strong)`, radius `--radius-xl`. `-card`: `1px solid var(--ui-border)`, `--ui-surface`, radius `--radius-xl`.
- Header: column, gap .375rem, `max-width: 24rem`.
- Icon tile: 3rem square, `--ui-surface-muted`, 1px `--ui-border-subtle`, radius `--radius-lg`, icon 1.5rem in `--ui-muted-foreground`; `margin-bottom: .625rem`.
- Title 15px/600, letter-spacing -.01em. Description 14px in `--ui-muted-foreground`.
- Actions: wrap, centred, gap .5rem.
- No shadows. Reads semantic tokens only.

#### Motion
- One entrance on mount: `var(--animate-rise)` (rise 8px, blur clears, `--ui-duration-slow`). Reduced motion: the global rule shortens it to 1ms.

#### Accessibility
- Plain headings and text; nothing is announced by itself. The icon is decorative (`aria-hidden`); the title carries the meaning.
- Description text meets 4.5:1 in light and dark.

#### Acceptance checks
- Default variant has no border; dashed has a dashed 1px border; card has a solid 1px border and surface background.
- Media icon tile is 48×48px with an icon 24px.
- Title renders as the chosen heading level.
- No serious axe violations in light and dark.

### `ui/components/empty-state/empty-state.tsx`

```tsx
import { forwardRef, type HTMLAttributes } from 'react';
import { cn } from '../../lib/cn';

export type EmptyVariant = 'default' | 'dashed' | 'card';

export interface EmptyProps extends HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement> {
  /**
   * `default`: no container, sits inside whatever surface holds it (a card, a table body).
   * `dashed`: a dashed outline that invites an action (drop zones, "add the first…").
   * `card`: a solid bordered surface of its own. Default `default`.
   */
  variant?: EmptyVariant;
}

/**
 * Empty — what to show when there is nothing yet. Server Component–safe.
 * Compose: EmptyHeader (EmptyMedia, EmptyTitle, EmptyDescription), EmptyActions.
 */
export const Empty = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, EmptyProps>(function Empty(
  { variant = 'default', className, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  return <div ref={ref} className={cn('ui-empty', variant !== 'default' && `ui-empty-${variant}`, className)} {...props} />;
});

/** Groups the media, title and description so they sit close together. */
export const EmptyHeader = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>>(function EmptyHeader(
  { className, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  return <div ref={ref} className={cn('ui-empty-header', className)} {...props} />;
});

export type EmptyMediaVariant = 'icon' | 'illustration';

export interface EmptyMediaProps extends HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement> {
  /** `icon`: puts an `Icon` in a soft rounded tile. `illustration`: a free slot for an image or SVG. Default `icon`. */
  variant?: EmptyMediaVariant;
}

export const EmptyMedia = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, EmptyMediaProps>(function EmptyMedia(
  { variant = 'icon', className, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  return <div ref={ref} className={cn('ui-empty-media', `ui-empty-media-${variant}`, className)} {...props} />;
});

export interface EmptyTitleProps extends HTMLAttributes<HTMLHeadingElement> {
  /** Heading element. Pick the level that fits the page outline; `div` for no heading. Default `h3`. */
  as?: 'h2' | 'h3' | 'h4' | 'h5' | 'h6' | 'div';
}

export const EmptyTitle = forwardRef<HTMLHeadingElement, EmptyTitleProps>(function EmptyTitle(
  { as: Tag = 'h3', className, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  return <Tag ref={ref as never} className={cn('ui-empty-title', className)} {...props} />;
});

export const EmptyDescription = forwardRef<HTMLParagraphElement, HTMLAttributes<HTMLParagraphElement>>(function EmptyDescription(
  { className, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  return <p ref={ref} className={cn('ui-empty-description', className)} {...props} />;
});

/** The next step: one primary button, optionally a secondary one. */
export const EmptyActions = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>>(function EmptyActions(
  { className, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  return <div ref={ref} className={cn('ui-empty-actions', className)} {...props} />;
});
```

### `ui/lib/cn.ts`

```ts
/**
 * Join class names, skipping falsy values.
 * No tailwind-merge needed: ui-* classes live in Tailwind's `components`
 * layer, so any utility passed in `className` already wins.
 */
export type ClassValue = string | number | false | null | undefined;

export function cn(...classes: ClassValue[]): string {
  let out = '';
  for (const c of classes) {
    if (!c) continue;
    out = out ? `${out} ${c}` : String(c);
  }
  return out;
}
```

### `ui/styles/components/empty-state.css`

```css
/* Empty state -------------------------------------------------------------
   .ui-empty  + variant: -dashed -card
   Parts: .ui-empty-header, .ui-empty-media (-icon | -illustration),
          .ui-empty-title, .ui-empty-description, .ui-empty-actions
   Centred column, max 24rem of copy. Entrance: one soft rise.
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------ */

@layer components {
  .ui-empty {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 1.25rem;
    padding: 2.5rem 1.5rem;
    text-align: center;
    color: var(--ui-foreground);
    text-wrap: balance;
    animation: var(--animate-rise);
  }
  .ui-empty-dashed {
    border: 1px dashed var(--ui-border-strong);
    border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
  }
  .ui-empty-card {
    border: 1px solid var(--ui-border);
    border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
    background-color: var(--ui-surface);
    color: var(--ui-surface-foreground);
  }

  .ui-empty-header {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.375rem;
    max-width: 24rem;
  }

  .ui-empty-media { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; margin-bottom: 0.625rem; }
  .ui-empty-media-icon {
    width: 3rem;
    height: 3rem;
    border: 1px solid var(--ui-border-subtle);
    border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
    background-color: var(--ui-surface-muted);
    color: var(--ui-muted-foreground);
  }
  .ui-empty-media-icon > svg { width: 1.5rem; height: 1.5rem; }
  .ui-empty-media-illustration { max-width: 12rem; }
  .ui-empty-media-illustration > svg,
  .ui-empty-media-illustration > img { display: block; width: 100%; height: auto; }

  .ui-empty-title {
    margin: 0;
    font-size: var(--text-md);
    line-height: var(--text-md--line-height);
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: -0.01em;
  }
  .ui-empty-description {
    margin: 0;
    font-size: var(--text-base);
    line-height: var(--text-base--line-height);
    color: var(--ui-muted-foreground);
  }
  .ui-empty-actions { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; }
}
```

### `ui/icons/icon.tsx`

```tsx
import { forwardRef, type SVGProps } from 'react';
import { cn } from '../lib/cn';
import { iconPaths, type IconName } from './paths';

export interface IconProps extends Omit<SVGProps<SVGSVGElement>, 'ref'> {
  /** Icon shape. */
  name: IconName;
  /** Pixel size (width and height). Default 16. */
  size?: number | string;
  /** Stroke width. Default 1.75. */
  strokeWidth?: number;
  /** Accessible label. Without it the icon is decorative (aria-hidden). */
  label?: string;
}

/**
 * Built-in stroke icon. Inherits `currentColor`.
 *   <Icon name="check" />   <Icon name="search" size={20} label="Search" />
 * Server Component–safe.
 */
export const Icon = forwardRef<SVGSVGElement, IconProps>(function Icon(
  { name, size = 16, strokeWidth = 1.75, label, className, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  return (
    <svg
      ref={ref}
      xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
      viewBox="0 0 24 24"
      width={size}
      height={size}
      fill="none"
      stroke="currentColor"
      strokeWidth={strokeWidth}
      strokeLinecap="round"
      strokeLinejoin="round"
      aria-hidden={label ? undefined : true}
      aria-label={label}
      role={label ? 'img' : undefined}
      focusable="false"
      className={cn('ui-icon', className)}
      // Static, library-owned SVG markup — never user input.
      dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: iconPaths[name] }}
      {...props}
    />
  );
});

export { iconPaths, type IconName };
```

## Usage

**No projects yet** — from the docs (`apps/docs/examples/empty-state/no-projects.tsx`), imports rewritten to `@/ui/...`:

```tsx
import { Button } from '@/ui/components/button';
import { Empty, EmptyActions, EmptyDescription, EmptyHeader, EmptyMedia, EmptyTitle } from '@/ui/components/empty-state';
import { Icon } from '@/ui/icons/icon';

export default function EmptyNoProjects() {
  return (
    <Empty>
      <EmptyHeader>
        <EmptyMedia>
          <Icon name="folder" />
        </EmptyMedia>
        <EmptyTitle>No projects yet</EmptyTitle>
        <EmptyDescription>Projects keep your files, members and deploys in one place. Create your first one to get started.</EmptyDescription>
      </EmptyHeader>
      <EmptyActions>
        <Button>
          <Icon name="plus" />
          New project
        </Button>
        <Button variant="outline">Import from GitHub</Button>
      </EmptyActions>
    </Empty>
  );
}
```
